calendar_2026_27.note: Bylaw 13.17.1 (revised 4/17/25). The contact period of 13.17.1(d) runs March 1 through the Sunday before the third Monday of August, so the August 1 rush is inside it; the spec's 'Mar 1 - Jul 31' row should read through Aug 16 (2026) / Aug 17 (2025).

formulas_13_17_1: third Monday of August through the second Thursday of September: quiet
Friday after the second Thursday of September through the second Sunday in October: contact

Monday after the second Sunday of October through February: quiet, except signing week Monday-Thursday dead; Tuesday before Thanksgiving through Sunday shutdown; Dec 22-27 shutdown; ABCA convention dead

March 1 through the Sunday before the third Monday of August: contact, except last Monday in May through the following Monday dead; Saturday before Father's Day through the Monday after dead; July 3-5 dead

dates.calls_and_correspondence_open: Aug 1 at the beginning of the junior year (13.1.3.2.3, 13.4.1.1; adopted 4/26/23)
dates.off_campus_contact_open: Sep 1 at the beginning of the junior year (13.1.1.1.1; revised 6/24/26, date unchanged)
dates.official_visits_per_school: one before Oct 15 after high school, one after; one more after a head-coach change (13.6.2.2, 13.6.2.2.1)
dates.signing_date: second Wednesday (7 a.m.) in November (13.02.13.1(f)): 2026-11-11; undergraduate transfers from the first day (7 a.m.) of their notification-of-transfer period, postgraduates from Oct 1 (13.02.13.2)
dates.signed_prospect_contact_ban_releases: aid reduced or cancelled; academically ineligible; not enrolled full time; release requested within 30 days of the head coach's departure; a granted release (two business days to answer, default grant) (13.1.1.2.1)
dates.roster_limit: 34 (17.2, effective 7/1/25); roster due the day before the first contest counted for selection or Dec 1, whichever is earlier (17.2.1)
dates.portal_windows: Dec 1-15; a 30-consecutive-day period beginning seven days after championship selections (13.1.1.4.1(h)); 2026-27: Dec 1-15, 2026 and Jun 7 - Jul 6, 2027
dates.portal_exceptions: head coach departs or announces departure: 30 consecutive days (13.1.1.4.1.1.1(a)); postgraduates may use the undergraduate exceptions (13.1.1.4.2.1)
dates.eligibility_clock: 12.6: five academic years from the earlier of the first full-time term attended or the academic year after the 19th birthday; revised 6/24/26 (effective 8/1/26) and 9/9/26: 12.6.1 a 19th birthday on Sep 1 - Dec 31 starts the clock the following fall; 12.6.2 first enrollment May 1 - Nov 1 starts the clock that fall, Nov 1 - May 1 the next regular term; 12.6.3 a clock ending with a fall term runs to the day before the spring term, and a championship that begins inside the period extends it to the team's last game; 12.6.10 no waivers
dates.incremental_scholarship_cap: $2.5M of aid above the 2024-25 sport limits counts against the cap (16.13.1.5)

changes_since_spec: 12.6.1-12.6.3 adopted 9/9/26 (clock start and end details); no baseball recruiting date changed; the women's flag football roster limit was the only 17.2 revision (8/25/26)

overage_penalties.>5-10%: 75% tax and the next first-round pick
overage_penalties.>10-15%: 100% tax and the next first- and second-round picks

slot_rules_current.guarantee_75pct: a top-300 prospect who takes the pre-draft physical is guaranteed 75% of slot (2022 CBA)
slot_rules_current.draft_and_follow: restored 2022 for picks who go to junior college; a bonus over $225,000 counts against the pool
slot_rules_current.eligibility: HS graduates not enrolled in college; four-year players after the junior year, three years after enrollment, or at 21; junior-college players any year
slot_rules_current.lottery: 18 non-playoff clubs for picks 1-6, worst three 16.5% each; payees at most two consecutive lottery picks, payors none consecutive; CBT second-surcharge clubs drop their top pick 10 places
slot_rules_current.ppi: a top-100 rookie (two of three lists) with a full service year who wins ROY or finishes top 3 in MVP/Cy Young pre-arbitration earns his club a pick after round 1
slot_rules_current.conf: A; every slot value 2021-2026 in data/mlb_draft/slot_values.csv

proposed_ruleset_2026.proposed: 2026-06-18 by MLB; re-tabled 2026-10-08 contingent on a salary cap and floor
proposed_ruleset_2026.terms: 12 rounds, hard slots, domestic pool $200M (from $358.7M), eligibility age 20 by Sep 1 and two years past high school from the 2028 draft (no HS or JUCO picks), sophomores eligible, unlimited passed-over signings (undrafted cap reported at $10,000, C), lottery 6 to 4, Competitive Balance picks eliminated, pick trading with limits; a separate 12-round international draft ($200M, age 18)
proposed_ruleset_2026.mlbpa_counter_2026_07_21: keep 20 rounds and HS/JUCO eligibility; sophomores eligible regardless of age; no hard slots; pools tied to revenue; softer overage penalties; move the draft back to June
proposed_ruleset_2026.status_2026_10_10: CBA expires 2026-12-01; no deal; lockout procedures circulated about Oct 1; no sessions scheduled
proposed_ruleset_2026.what_it_changes_for_the_sim: the 115-127 HS and 12-47 JC picks a year go to zero and stay in the amateur pool until age 20; sophomores (20-30 picks a year today) become draftable; about 360 domestic picks instead of about 614; no signability bargaining (fixed slots), no unsigned-pick compensation; MLB's rationale: 75% of domestic MLB players came through college, 85% of drafted HS players are P4 commits
proposed_ruleset_2026.conf: A for MLB's statement, B for the status
